children: AstraZeneca Q3 2026: revenue $16.21B (+7% YoY CER), core EPS $2.79, net income $3.12B. Reaffirmed FY26 guidance; RSG program: up to $2B restructuring, ~$1.5B annual savings by 2029.
AstraZeneca (AZN) saw oncology sales rise 17% year‑on‑year. Farxiga sales fell ~25% due to generics. Etcamah breast cancer trial missed its primary endpoint; a lung cancer study was halted.
AstraZeneca (AZN) has 20+ Phase III readouts planned through 2027 and aims for an $80 billion valuation by 2030.
AstraZeneca (AZN) paid $40M upfront to partner with insitro on drug discovery for MASH and cardiomyopathies, with up to ~$1.46B in milestones and single-digit royalties; AZN keeps global rights.
AstraZeneca bought ~12% of Summit Therapeutics for $2B and began clinical collaborations to test sonesitatug vedotin and Datroway combined with Summit’s ivonescimab in oncology.
AstraZeneca (AZN) saw its cancer drug anastrozole kept at ₹3,541 in India while other brands faced bigger cuts amid a new 30% trade-margin cap on high-cost originator drugs.
AstraZeneca (AZN) says its restructuring won’t cut net jobs. CFO notes staff will undergo reskilling and upskilling as part of the reorganization, per company comments.
AstraZeneca (AZN) opened a Kendall Square R&D center in Cambridge, MA. The U.S. hub will house about 2,000 researchers, expanding AstraZeneca’s U.S. R&D presence.
AstraZeneca PLC (AZN) is holding its Q3 2026 earnings call live; guidance will follow. The session is hosted on TradingView due to mobile app limitations.
